locator.title: Грудное вскармливание без стресса: что нужно знать маме
locator.lead: Развеиваем мифы о грудном вскармливании и знакомим с комплексом Фемибион®

current_heading.text: Миф 5. Витамины при ГВ — это маркетинг, достаточно просто хорошо питаться

nearest_text_before.text: Еще сложнее ситуация с кальцием. Его ежедневно нужно 1300 мг, но в одном стакане молока — около 300 мг нутриента [2]. В таких случаях можно обратить внимание на витаминно-минеральные комплексы, состав которых учитывает потребности кормящих женщин [2]. Например, в рамках профессиональной консультации могут посоветовать Фемибион® 2 [11].

nearest_text_after.text: Комплекс существует на рынке уже более 15 лет и постоянно совершенствуется. За это время специалисты улучшали состав продукта и добавляли в него инновационные компоненты, чтобы он отвечал всем российским и международным стандартам.

image_reading: Front-facing Femibion 2 carton fills the frame, with prominent purple branding, an orange lower panel, and a maternal silhouette.
The packaging contains dense readable Russian text and fixed graphic elements, so its layout must remain unchanged.
A subtle optical accent can travel across the existing orange band without altering the package.
analysis.article_context: Gallery product image in the section explaining that vitamin and mineral complexes can support nutritional needs during breastfeeding; it presents Femibion 2 as a stable, trustworthy product package.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: The product is presented as a calm, reliable source of nutritional support for a breastfeeding mother and baby.
structured_intent.primary_action: A soft warm highlight travels across the existing orange lower panel of the package.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The highlight has faded at the right edge, leaving the original package intact and clearly readable.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: Femibion 2 remains a stable, trustworthy and fully legible product presentation throughout.

models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, a restrained warm highlight begins on the left side of the existing orange lower panel and moves smoothly across it, reinforcing the product's supportive role. The camera stays fixed so all packaging text and graphics remain stable. The sheen reaches the right side near the end and gently settles without introducing another event.
models.positive_prompt: A soft warm sheen travels slowly across the orange lower band of the Femibion 2 package, then fades near the right edge. Fixed camera; the final frame shows the intact, fully readable package with a faint settled glow.

models.scene_plan: For this five-second version, a soft optical shimmer grows from the left within the orange band, travels evenly through the panel for most of the shot, and dissipates at the right edge near the final moment. Keep the camera locked and the carton perfectly stable, with the final visible state being the unchanged package and a subtle residual warmth.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed product shot. A gentle warm highlight glides across the orange lower panel and settles at its right edge; the carton remains intact and fully readable in the last frame.

models.scene_plan: Across four seconds, use one concise optical motion: a warm glint moves left to right only over the existing orange lower panel. It progresses steadily and fades as it reaches the right side close to the endpoint. The camera remains fixed; the last frame retains the same complete, legible product package.
models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera on the product package. A soft warm glint sweeps across the orange lower band and fades at the right edge, ending with the original carton fully readable and unchanged.
